theorem QOU.Torsion.MassTraceMarkov.jonesFn_wordBraid_eq_tlStateSum {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (q qi : R) {m : ℕ} (wi : R) (hqi : q * qi = 1) (w : Fin 2 → R) (hw : (1 + q ^ 2) * wi = 1) (ℓs : List (Fin m × Bool)) :
IwahoriHecke.JonesNormalisation.jonesFn q qi wi hqi w hw (wordBraid ℓs) = ↑(IwahoriHecke.JonesNormalisation.strandFactor q qi wi hqi hw ^ (m + 1)) * ↑(IwahoriHecke.JonesNormalisation.writheFactor q qi hqi ^ signedLength ℓs) * ∑ s : Fin ℓs.length → Bool, tlStateWeight q qi ℓs s * (wi ^ (m + 1) * (IwahoriHecke.QuantumTrace.siteWeight w * tlStateMatrix q qi ℓs s).trace)

theorem QOU.Torsion.MassTraceMarkov.braidTrace_wordBraid_eq_leadProd_add_tlStates {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (q qi : R) {m : ℕ} (hqi : q * qi = 1) (w : Fin 2 → R) (wi : R) (hw : (∑ k : Fin 2, w k) * wi = 1) (ℓs : List (Fin m × Bool)) :
IwahoriHecke.BraidGroup.braidTrace q qi hqi w wi (wordBraid ℓs) = (List.map (letterLeadScalar q qi) ℓs).prod + ∑ s ∈ Finset.univ.erase fun (x : Fin ℓs.length) => false, tlStateWeight q qi ℓs s * (wi ^ (m + 1) * (IwahoriHecke.QuantumTrace.siteWeight w * tlStateMatrix q qi ℓs s).trace)

theorem QOU.Torsion.MassTraceMarkov.stateProd_smul_eq {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {α : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (c : α → Bool → R) (M : α → Bool → A) (w : List α) (s : Fin w.length → Bool) :
stateProd (fun (a : α) (b : Bool) => c a b • M a b) w s = stateProd c w s • stateProd M w s

theorem QOU.Torsion.MassTraceMarkov.stateProd_const_false {α : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} [Semiring A] (f : α → Bool → A) (w : List α) :
(stateProd f w fun (x : Fin w.length) => false) = (List.map (fun (a : α) => f a false) w).prod

theorem QOU.Torsion.MassTraceMarkov.prod_map_add_eq_sum_stateProd {α : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} [Semiring A] (f : α → Bool → A) (w : List α) :
(List.map (fun (a : α) => f a false + f a true) w).prod = ∑ s : Fin w.length → Bool, stateProd f w s

theorem QOU.Torsion.MassTraceMarkov.sum_fin_succ_bool {M : Type u_2} [AddCommMonoid M] {n : ℕ} (g : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → M) :
∑ s : Fin (n + 1) → Bool, g s = ∑ b : Bool, ∑ s : Fin n → Bool, g (Fin.cons b s)

IwahoriHecke.JonesNormalisation.jonesFn q qi wi hqi w hw (wordBraid ℓs) = ↑(IwahoriHecke.JonesNormalisation.strandFactor q qi wi hqi hw ^ (m + 1)) * ↑(IwahoriHecke.JonesNormalisation.writheFactor q qi hqi ^ signedLength ℓs) * (wi ^ (m + 1) * (IwahoriHecke.QuantumTrace.siteWeight w * hol q qi ℓs).trace)
